## Goal
WO-308 covers five distro READMEs but not Nix. Give `distro/nix/README.md` the same honest status, and bring `distro/CHECKLIST.md` in line with 0.3.1.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- `distro/nix/README.md` says: community recipe, not submitted upstream, version read from `pyproject.toml` (`distro/nix/flake.nix` line 23, in words), how a maintainer would build and check it, and what isn't tested.
- `distro/CHECKLIST.md`: every recipe file it names exists; every version it names is 0.3.1 or is described as "the current release"; the publish gate (SEC-112) is unchanged in meaning; steps that need the network are clearly marked "release-day, in-house" and are not done here.
- No hash is filled in; placeholders stay placeholders.
- `tests/copilot/test_cp_packaging_lint.py` and `tests/copilot/test_cp_wording_guard.py` still pass (no channel described as available).

**Limits (every Grok WO, CLAUDE-G-004):** text only and offline. No network, credentials, git or gh, installs, or running the real app against real sites; never read anything outside the repo. Fake people only (Jane Q Testperson, Springfield IL). Plain words per `docs/POSITIONING.md`: no "guarantee", "erase", "100%" or "nothing is sent"; say "requested" and "confirmed". A real product bug is a file:line finding in VENDOR_STATUS.md (or a strict `xfail` in a test); never edit `src/`. Tests pass on Windows too (`tmp_path`, `pathlib`). Check `tests/copilot/`, `tests/codex/` and `tests/grok/` first; don't duplicate a guard.
